verdict: CrowdStrike grew revenue 22% to $1.23B and added a record $265M of net new ARR, but stock pay and July 19 Incident costs kept the quarter in the red — a $34M net loss — even as free cash flow hit $296M.

kpis.label: ARR
kpis.note: +23% YoY; $265M net new ARR in Q3, +73%

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: in Q3 FY26, a record for the quarter

segments.name: Subscription
segments.note: The Falcon security platform, sold by subscription — 95% of all revenue.

segments.name: Professional services
segments.note: Security experts for hire — incident response and setup help.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling Falcon to enterprises — the biggest running cost.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the Falcon platform and its AI defenses.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — includes costs tied to the July 19 Incident and related matters.

otherDetail: Interest income of $50.9M plus $2.2M of other income, net, less $6.9M of interest expense — a net $46.2M gain outside operations.
oneTimers: Costs tied to the July 19 Incident and related matters were $26.2M in the quarter, up from $33.9M a year ago.
Stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes were $293.3M — the main reason non-GAAP net income attributable to CrowdStrike ($245.4M) contrasts with the GAAP attributable net loss ($34.0M).
The $34.0M net loss is the consolidated total; $0.0M of income belonged to a non-controlling interest, leaving a $34.0M net loss attributable to CrowdStrike.
footerNote: Consolidated net loss was $34.0M; attributable to CrowdStrike, $34.0M.

takeaways.title: ARR accelerated
takeaways.text: Ending ARR grew 23% to $4.92B, with a record $265.3M of net new ARR added in the quarter — net new ARR growth accelerated to 73% YoY.

takeaways.title: In the red on paper
takeaways.text: The GAAP operating loss was $69.4M as $293.3M of stock-based compensation weighed; non-GAAP operating income was a record $264.6M.

takeaways.title: Cash flow tells another story
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was a Q3-record $295.9M on $397.5M of operating cash flow — CrowdStrike's cash generation is far stronger than its GAAP result suggests.
